# homeassistant_input_datetime (Resource)

A date and/or time helper (`input_datetime`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A time of day only. The entity is input_datetime.wake_up.
resource "homeassistant_input_datetime" "wake_up" {
  name     = "Wake Up"
  has_time = true
  initial  = "06:30"
}

# A date and a time.
resource "homeassistant_input_datetime" "party" {
  name     = "Party"
  has_date = true
  has_time = true
  initial  = "2026-12-31 20:00:00"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Changing it renames the helper in place.

### Optional

- `has_date` (Boolean) Whether the helper holds a date. At least one of `has_date` and `has_time` must be true. Defaults to `false`.
- `has_time` (Boolean) Whether the helper holds a time of day. Defaults to `false`.
- `icon` (String) Icon, e.g. `mdi:toggle-switch`.
- `id` (String) Helper ID, a slug such as `guest_mode`. Home Assistant derives it from `name` when the helper is created, and keeps it when the helper is renamed. Set it to choose the ID yourself. Changing it replaces the helper. Creation fails if the ID is taken. Import with this ID.
- `initial` (String) Value the helper starts with when Home Assistant starts: `2026-12-24` with only a date, `18:30` or `18:30:00` with only a time, `2026-12-24 18:30:00` with both. Unset, it restores the value it had before the restart. The provider never manages the current value.

### Read-Only

- `entity_id` (String) Entity ID of the helper, `input_datetime.<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an input_datetime helper by its ID.
tofu import homeassistant_input_datetime.wake_up wake_up
```
